unlockLines: Welcome to Social Security, where nobody is secure and I am barely social. Untangle their identity, beta. Your own remains a disappointment.
Become the department of Who The Hell Are You. Very prestigious. We printed the badge on the back of a lunch receipt.
An identity crisis! Finally, a customer with something in common with our management team. Be official. Try remembering your own name first.
Tell them everything is under control. Your chair is broken, your boss is sweating, and the government is apparently you. Beautiful system.
Social Security unlocked. You now have bureaucratic authority and absolutely no pension. Congratulations on this remarkable fucking promotion.
title: Social Security
